title: Steven Lovkin: Eisenhower said he no longer controlled the UFO issue

tellings.quote: one of our whistleblowers was a young army guy at the White House in the Eisenhower in the signal corps I think 5960 named Steven Lovkin. You can read his testimony in our material and he said that Eisenhower would doodle pictures of these you know ET craft and he was fascinated and he brought the issue up to Eisenhower and said Eisenhower said well I don't have control of this anymore.

related.note: Both are Lovekin's testimony that Eisenhower doodled UFO craft. This telling puts it at Mount Weather as UFO headquarters; the story has it at the White House, with Eisenhower saying he no longer controlled the issue.

plain: President Eisenhower is said to have doodled pictures of alien craft and, when the subject was raised, to have said 'well I don't have control of this anymore.' Steven Greer, who runs a project that gathers testimony from people claiming inside knowledge of UFOs, tells Michels this from the testimony of Stephen Lovekin, a young Army man in the Signal Corps at the White House around 1959 and 1960. If true, it would mean a sitting president had lost control of the issue.
